job.job_description:
Client : A fast growing data-science company, serving clients across industries and geographies.
Position : AI Engineer
Experience : 6 months to 2 years
Location : Noida / Bengaluru
Work Mode : In Office only
Joining : Immediate to 30 days
CTC Offered: To discuss
Job Overview: Looking for an AI Engineer to build the next generation of LLM powered conversational and agentic systems. If you re passionate about applied AI and want to work on cutting edge integrations, this role is for you.

Responsibilities
a) Design and optimize LLM applications (prompting, context, RAG, multi agent orchestration).
b) Build Python APIs and integrations using frameworks like LangChain/LangGraph and vector databases.
c) Ensure reliability with guardrails, monitoring, and CRM/external system integrations.
Requirements
a) 6 months to 2 years of experience in Data Science / Applied ML.
b) Strong Python skills and familiarity with AI/ML libraries.
c) Hands on with LangChain/LangGraph and vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate).
d) Understanding of prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, and multi agent systems.
e) A plus if you have experience integrating AI with enterprise platforms.
Qualifications
BE / BTech in Computer Engineering / Information Technology / Artificial Intelligence from a Tier1 / Tier2 institution


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
